about: Live-steered duel data. Per-lane blocks: steer/stances/tactics/profileClamp (S1), reactions (S2), ui (S3), auto (S4). Lanes edit only their own block. profile ops: set (absolute), mul, add on AiProfile knobs (AiRead.cs:20), applied set->mul->add, then profileClamp. Times: seconds, counted in sim ticks (Duel.TickCount, 60/s).

reactions._about: S2 reactions (replaces 'tells'). Per incoming swing type the defender draws guard / parry attempt / roll / sidestep / trade (swing back) / ignore (remainder). Probabilities = byMove x side.skill x stanceMul x running tacticMul (Dracula only), renormalised if the sum exceeds 1. Executed by the existing AIBrain (knobs parry/dodge/lapse/guard/reaction overridden for that one swing) or by PressSidestep / Press. Delays in ms (60 Hz ticks = ms*0.06), randomised +- jitter. punish = chance to attack the recovery after a whiff (+bonus for a missed or blocked heavy). repeatPenalty/mixup/patienceAmp = anti-pattern layer on profile.pressure / profile.aggression. feintBiteChance: the Pitborn bites on Dracula's feint; a bite is countered by a free parry + riposte window.
